onboarding.label: App tour

welcome.title: Welcome to Kniho-hlod!
welcome.text: I'm the bookworm, and in a minute I'll show you what you can do here: books, shelves, loans, friends and reminders.
welcome.fillSamplesHint: A few books, shelves and loans to show things on. One button in Account settings removes them.
welcome.skip: Skip, take me to the app

onboarding.samplesNote: Remove the samples with the button at the top of the page or in Account settings once you want to start for real.

home.title: Your overview
home.text: How many books you have, what you're reading, what's lent out and what's overdue. An overdue loan turns red, so you won't miss it.

books.title: Adding books is quick
books.text: Type the ISBN or scan the barcode with your phone — I'll look up the title, author and cover in the catalogues. Typing it all in works too.

shelves.title: A shelf for everything
shelves.text: Sort your books onto shelves: favourites, holiday reads, for the kids… One book can stand on several shelves.

loans.title: Who has which book?
loans.text: When you lend a book, note who has it and until when. You add the contact right there, and one button marks it returned.

friends.title: Kniho-hlod with friends
friends.text: Invite friends with a link, a QR code or by e-mail. Once you share your library they see your books and what you are reading — never your notes or loans.

comments.title: Talk about books
comments.text: Under any of your friends' books you can say how you liked it or suggest what to read next. Only the book's owner and their friends see the comments.

borrow.title: Borrow from friends
borrow.text: Like a book in a friend's library? Ask for it with one button and they can lend it to you. What you've borrowed from friends is here, and I'll remind you before it's due.

reminders.title: I keep an eye on due dates
reminders.text: A few days before a book is due I'll e-mail you, and if it doesn't come back, I'll remind you again. Set how many days ahead here.

done.title: That's it!
done.text: The library is yours now. You can take the tour again from the menu under your avatar — you can also report a bug or an idea there.

samples.title: Sample data
samples.text: Your library holds sample books, shelves, contacts and loans from the tour. Remove them once you want to start for real — your own books stay.

libraryImport.title: Import your library
libraryImport.intro: Do you keep your books on Goodreads or Databáze knih? Download an export there and upload it here. We bring over titles, authors, ISBNs, ratings, reading status and shelves.
libraryImport.link: Have your books elsewhere? Import them from Goodreads or Databáze knih.

goodreads.title: From Goodreads
goodreads.steps: On goodreads.com open My Books → Import and export (bottom left) → Export Library. Download the CSV file and upload it here.

databazeKnih.title: From Databáze knih
databazeKnih.steps: On databazeknih.cz open your library and download it with the export button as an Excel table (.xlsx), then upload it here. Any other table works too if it has a Title column.
